SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q3. In an isosceles triangle ABC, if AC = BC and AB^2 = 2AC^2, then ∠C is equal to:
(a) 30°
(b) 45°
(c) 90°
(d) 60°

Answer / Solution:
Given AB^2 = 2AC^2 and AC = BC.
So AB^2 = AC^2 + BC^2.
By converse of Pythagoras theorem, triangle ABC is right-angled at C.
Answer: (c) 90°
